headline: Viji Finance appoints M/s DDS & Associates to a new role
summary: Viji Finance Limited has informed the stock exchange about the appointment of M/s DDS & Associates to the company with effect from November 24, 2026. The specific designation or function of the appointee was stated as 'Other' in the exchange filing. This is a routine corporate governance and administrative update from the micro-cap non-banking financial company. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural appointment has negligible impact on the company's financial performance or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no financial impact on your portfolio.

headline: Viji Finance releases voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Viji Finance concludes postal ballot process

modes.bear: The filing provides no new information on business growth or financial performance, reflecting a lack of material developments.
modes.bull: The successful completion of the postal ballot indicates stable corporate governance and adherence to regulatory compliance standards.
modes.simple: Viji Finance has finished a voting process where shareholders cast their ballots. The company has now shared the final results and an official report on how the voting was conducted.

summary: Viji Finance Limited has officially submitted its scrutinizer's report following a postal ballot process. The company has also disclosed the final voting results to the National Stock Exchange. This filing confirms the completion of the shareholder voting procedure for the company's recent resolutions.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance update with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Viji Finance reports strong revenue growth for September quarter
summary: Viji Finance recorded standalone net sales of Rs 2.77 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. This represents a 380.27% increase compared to the same period last year. The company operates in the financial services sector.
why_it_matters: Significant revenue growth for a small-cap financial services firm.
